description: This is a modern L-shaped desk with a minimalist design. The tabletop is white and appears to be a smooth, solid material, possibly laminate or a composite. The frame is constructed from thin, black metal tubing, forming a simple yet sturdy base. The desk is designed to fit into a corner, offering a generous workspace. One section extends straight, while the other angles off to form the L-shape. The overall aesthetic is clean and functional, suitable for a home office or study space.
